findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_providers, check_email_spam_score · Private data: add_contact, add_contacts, list_contacts, remove_contact, update_contact_tags, list_tags, schedule_campaign, check_domain_deliverability · Public sink: create_campaign, add_provider, list_providers, send_test_email, check_email_spam_score · Destructive: remove_contact, delete_campaign, delete_campaign_step, remove_provider, delete_task, retry_failed.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_providers, check_email_spam_score · Private data: add_contact, add_contacts, list_contacts, remove_contact, update_contact_tags, list_tags, schedule_campaign, check_domain_deliverability · Public sink: create_campaign, add_provider, list_providers, send_test_email, check_email_spam_score · Destructive: remove_contact, delete_campaign, delete_campaign_step, remove_provider, delete_task, retry_failed

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
